meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你发现并安装可用的 agent 技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问「有没有技能能做 X」
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install agent skills on demand
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask 'is there a skill for X'

howto.what: 安装后，当你想做某事但不确定有没有现成技能时，Claude 会帮你搜索并推荐可安装的技能，还能直接帮你安装。
howto.when: 当你问“怎么实现X”、“有没有做X的技能”或表示想扩展Claude的能力时触发。

say.text: 有没有帮我做代码审查的技能？
say.note: Claude 会搜索相关技能并推荐安装命令。

say.text: 怎么优化我的React应用性能？
say.note: Claude 会搜索React性能优化技能。

say.text: 帮我找一个生成变更日志的技能。

howto.what_en: When installed, if you ask how to do something or if a skill exists, Claude will search for and recommend installable skills, and can install them for you.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", or express interest in extending Claude's capabilities.

say_en.text: Is there a skill for code review?
say_en.note: Claude will search and recommend a skill.

say_en.text: How can I optimize my React app?
say_en.note: Claude will search for React performance skills.

say_en.text: Find a skill to generate changelogs.
say_en.note: Claude will search for changelog skills.
